phases.name: Phase 1
phases.focus: Establish safe mechanics, build confidence, and maintain strength with controlled loads.

phases.name: Phase 2
phases.focus: Progress load within safe ranges, emphasize technique and pelvic floor engagement.

phases.name: Phase 3
phases.focus: Maintain gains with progressive overload limits and variety while respecting pregnancy considerations.

non_negotiables: moderate strength only as cleared by OB
full gym equipment allowed with modifications as needed
avoid Valsalva during rounds; maintain diaphragmatic breathing and bracing
avoid exercises that cause diastasis symptoms or discomfort in the abdominal region
avoid prone positions after early pregnancy; switch to supported seated or standing variations

stage2.text:
PLAN "Prenatal Strength Program 12 Weeks"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Moderate strength maintenance with safe progressive overload during pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY lower_pull training 60m "Phase 1 - Lower Pull"
        warmup:
          row 5m
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY upper_push training 60m "Phase 1 - Upper Push"
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_pressed 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY lower_push training 60m "Phase 1 - Lower Push"
        warmup:
          leg_mirrors 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY conditioning/recovery training 40m "Phase 1 - Conditioning"
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bike_or_row 20m rpe 5
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
  WEEK 2:
      DAY lower_pull training 60m "Phase 1 - Lower Pull"
        warmup:
          row 5m
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x9 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 3x9 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY upper_push training 60m "Phase 1 - Upper Push"
        warmup:

        main straight_sets:

          dumbbell_fly 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds

      DAY lower_push training 60m "Phase 1 - Lower Push"

          leg_extension 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY conditioning/recovery training 40m "Phase 1 - Conditioning"
        warmup:
          march_in_place 5m
        main straight_sets:
          elliptical 15m rpe 5
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
  WEEK 3:
